008package paint.viewer.override.square_override;
009
010import paint.shared.utils.TextFiles;
011import static paint.shared.constants.PaintStringConstants.SQUARE_NUMBER;
012import static paint.shared.constants.PaintStringConstants.CELL_ID;
013import static paint.shared.constants.PaintStringConstants.TIME_STAMP;
014import static paint.shared.constants.PaintStringConstants.EXPERIMENT_NAME;
015import static paint.shared.constants.PaintStringConstants.RECORDING_NAME;
016
017import paint.shared.objects.Square;
018import paint.shared.utils.PaintLogger;
019import paint.shared.utils.PaintRuntime;
020import paint.viewer.model.RecordingEntry;
021
022import tech.tablesaw.api.Table;
023
024import java.nio.file.Files;
025import java.nio.file.Path;
026import java.util.ArrayList;
027import java.util.HashMap;
028import java.util.List;
029import java.util.Map;
030import java.util.stream.Collectors;
031
032/**
033 * Loads and applies per-square override values to {@link Square} objects.
034 * <p>
035 * Each override row in the CSV sets a new {@code cellId} for one specific square
036 * in a specific recording. Matching uses a stable composite key:
037 * <pre>
038 *   experimentName + "§" + recordingName + "§" + squareNumber
039 * </pre>
040 * <p>
041 * This class mutates in-memory squares only; it does not persist any output.
042 */
043public final class ImportSquareOverride {
044
045    // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
046    // PUBLIC ENTRY POINT (RecordingEntries + projectPath)
047    // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
048
049    /**
050     * Loads overrides (if present) and applies them to all {@link Square} objects
051     * referenced by the provided {@link RecordingEntry} list.
052     *
053     * @param recordingEntries all recordings whose squares should be updated
054     * @param projectPath      the project root containing {@code Viewer/Square Override.csv}
055     */
056    public static void importSquareOverrides(List<RecordingEntry> recordingEntries, Path projectPath) {
057
058        Path csvPath = projectPath.resolve("Viewer").resolve("Square Override.csv");
059        if (!Files.exists(csvPath)) {
060            PaintLogger.infof("No Square Override.csv present - no overrides to apply.");
061            return;
062        }
063
064        List<SquareOverride> overrides = loadSquareOverride(csvPath);
065
066        // Flatten all squares from all recordings into one list so overrides can be applied in one pass.
067        List<Square> allSquares = new ArrayList<>();
068        for (RecordingEntry recordingEntry : recordingEntries) {
069            allSquares.addAll(recordingEntry.getRecording().getSquaresOfRecording());
070        }
071
072        applyInternal(allSquares, overrides);
073    }
074
075    // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
076    // INTERNAL APPLY
077    // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
078
079    /**
080     * Applies overrides to the provided list of {@link Square} objects.
081     * Only squares with a matching composite key are updated.
082     *
083     * @param squares   list of Square objects from one or more recordings
084     * @param overrides parsed override objects loaded from CSV
085     */
086    private static void applyInternal(List<Square> squares, List<SquareOverride> overrides) {
087
088        // Map: key(exp, rec, squareNumber) → overridden cellId
089        Map<String, Integer> overrideCellIds = new HashMap<>();
090
091        for (SquareOverride override : overrides) {
092            String key = key(override.getExperimentName(),
093                             override.getRecordingName(),
094                             override.getSquareNumber());
095            overrideCellIds.put(key, override.getCellId());
096        }
097
098        int applied = 0;
099
100        // Apply overrides in-place to the in-memory Square list.
101        for (Square square : squares) {
102
103            String experimentName = square.getExperimentName();
104            String recordingName  = square.getRecordingName();
105            int    squareNumber   = square.getSquareNumber();
106
107            String key = key(experimentName, recordingName, squareNumber);
108
109            Integer newCellId = overrideCellIds.get(key);
110
111            // Only apply if an override exists and the value actually changes.
112            if (newCellId != null && newCellId != square.getCellId()) {
113                int oldCellId  = square.getCellId();   // capture BEFORE change
114
115                square.setCellId(newCellId);
116                applied++;
117
118                if (PaintRuntime.isVerbose()) {
119                    PaintLogger.infof(
120                            "Updated square: %s / %s / #%3d | cellId %2d → %2d",
121                            square.getExperimentName(),
122                            square.getRecordingName(),
123                            square.getSquareNumber(),
124                            oldCellId,
125                            newCellId);
126                }
127            }
128        }
129
130        // Summary logging (grouped per recording) when any updates were applied.
131        if (applied > 0) {
132            Map<String, Long> squaresPerRecording =
133                    overrides.stream()
134                             .collect(Collectors.groupingBy(
135                                     SquareOverride::getRecordingName,
136                                     Collectors.counting()
137                             ));
138
139            PaintLogger.infof("Applied squares overrides:");
140            for (String rec : squaresPerRecording.keySet()) {
141                PaintLogger.infof("                    %s: %d squares", rec, squaresPerRecording.get(rec));
142            }
143        }
144    }
145
146    // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
147    // CSV LOADING
148    // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
149
150    /**
151     * Loads square overrides from {@code Square Override.csv}.
152     *
153     * @param csvFile full path to the override file
154     * @return a list of {@link SquareOverride} objects parsed from the CSV
155     */
156    public static List<SquareOverride> loadSquareOverride(Path csvFile) {
157
158        List<SquareOverride> list = new ArrayList<>();
159
160        try {
161            Table table = Table.read().usingOptions(TextFiles.csvReadOptions(csvFile));
162
163            for (int i = 0; i < table.rowCount(); i++) {
164
165                SquareOverride squareOverride = new SquareOverride();
166
167                squareOverride.setExperimentName(table.column(EXPERIMENT_NAME).get(i).toString());
168                squareOverride.setRecordingName(table.column(RECORDING_NAME).get(i).toString());
169                squareOverride.setSquareNumber(Integer.parseInt(table.column(SQUARE_NUMBER).get(i).toString()));
170                squareOverride.setCellId(Integer.parseInt(table.column(CELL_ID).get(i).toString()));
171                squareOverride.setTimestamp(table.column(TIME_STAMP).get(i).toString());
172
173                list.add(squareOverride);
174            }
175
176        } catch (Exception ex) {
177            PaintLogger.errorf("Error reading Square Override.csv → " + ex.getMessage());
178        }
179
180        return list;
181    }
182
183    /**
184     * Builds a composite override lookup key.
185     */
186    private static String key(String experimentName,
187            String recordingName,
188            int squareId) {
189        return experimentName + "§" + recordingName + "§" + squareId;
190    }
191
192    /** Private constructor — utility class. */
193    private ImportSquareOverride() {}
194}
